column5: after a program switch: writes the depth-compare constants (floatToFp24 of texObj+0x50) and fog constants through the glContext+0x1280 callback, per-unit scale vectors, and copies the cached state block into glContext+0x1e88..0x1f34
program binding mode switch (param_2 mode): updates the stream register entry for glContext+0x276c and calls the glContext+0x1330 dirty callback
removes a program entry from the program list glContext+0x1e7c (count at +0x1e74), compacting the list
frees a program entry buffer and removes it from the program list, then frees its state
sets the dirty byte (+0x119) of every bound program in the program table and shader list
copies the current program entry stream setup (stream registers, counts) into the destination state object
decides from the GL depth/stencil state and framebuffer flags whether hierarchical Z stays enabled (SC_HYPERZ_EN, glContext+0x1ae0)
walks the program table and flags programs whose cached flag byte differs from the wanted value for revalidation
copies a per-unit texture scale vector into the constant bank of a program entry for the units that need it
emits a command packet with the register pairs (0x854 / 0x878) from glContext+0x2440 / +0x2444
returns the polygon offset / depth scale for the current depth precision as an integer
recomputes the depth bias scale and polygon offset constants, then revalidates the viewport and polygon offset
recomputes the point size / line width fixed-point values at glContext+0x1cc..0x1cd8 and revalidates the viewport
returns the fog colour channel (1 red, 2 green, 3 blue) scaled to 8 bits and split into the two-field word
translates the GL fog mode / parameters into the fog constants and colour fields of the context
writes one 16-bit half of the paired route registers at glContext+0x1be4 / +0x1c04 for an output slot
combines the GL colour write masks with the colour format channel masks into glContext+0x1af4
limits the elements per vertex packet from the element sizes so that they fit the 0x80-dword FIFO (glContext+0x1b7c)
installs the shader handler function pointer tables (glContext+0x1190..0x11b0, +0x1350) for the selected EXT_vertex_shader mode
looks up a symbol by id in the shader / global lists and returns its storage word
looks up a symbol by id in the shader / global lists and returns its storage kind word (0x81 default)
looks up a symbol by id and fills a 5-word storage info record (zeroed when not found)
returns the bit mask of vertex shader input units whose flag byte is set
creates one vector symbol per element, chained to the first through the parent id
validates and appends a swizzle instruction (op 0x879a) with four output selects to the current shader
returns the constant upload buffer (allocated on first use), register count and register base of the current program
compacts the program entry table dropping unused symbol entries and shrinks the group counts
clears the symbol in-use flags and copies the shader state into the current shader fields of the context
maps an operand symbol id to a symbol index in the shader-local list (copying dependents from the global list) and fills the operand record
loads (or clears) bit 0 of the 16 words at glContext+0x18a0 from the per-unit flag bytes of a program entry
allocates a 0xc-byte list node holding glContext+0x2448
frees every node of the list object at glContext+0x11b4
copies the route register words of the current vertex program into glContext+0x1be4 / +0x1c04
